references.text: Joshua sets up the ambush behind the city, which the king of Ai did not know about
Describes the location of the ambush that lay hidden behind Ai
The first encounter between Israel and the men of Ai in battle, where Israel was defeated
A similar military strategy with an ambush was used against Benjamin at Gibeah
The Arabah plain is mentioned as a geographical reference point
An example of someone who did not know about the trap laid for them
The Lord hardened the enemies' hearts so that they came out to battle without knowing God's plan
